description: This file defines the functionality for deleting a follower relationship in a social media or social Networking feature. It contains a command, validation logic, and a handler that interacts with the database context to remove a follower for the current user based on the provided username.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username provided in the command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of a follower relationship by removing the target user from the current user's followed list and returning the profile information.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the logic to remove a follower from the current user and fetches the updated profile information.
